objective: Generate successor revisions of the implementation, module and quality-evidence registers from one exact source identity without modifying historical canonical/generated files.

execution_identity.failed_attempt_policy: Do not overwrite partial outputs; allocate a new refresh ID and new output paths after recording the failed attempt.

implementation_manifest: Bind the exact 2026-07-26 source snapshot identity.
Do not claim a clean commit.
module_register: Inventory MOD-ANDROID-ADMIN as source present but operationally incomplete.
Inventory MOD-ANDROID-GATEWAY as an independent NOT_DEPLOYED service candidate.
Inventory backend, model, voice and legacy Web boundaries.
quality_evidence_register: Record exact-subject backend and disposable PostGIS evidence without production expansion.
Record formal planned count 279, formal status NOT_RUN and formal PASS count 0.
Keep actual-device interactive, cross-process, reproducible rebuild, attestation and signing status uncompleted.
Do not convert candidate test source presence into PASS.
refresh_receipt: Record all input SHA-256 values captured before generation.
Record every output SHA-256 and byte count.
Record validation check IDs and results.
Record execution start and completion timestamps.
Record the single refresh ID and confirm that no historical file was modified.

required_checks.assertion: All exact input identities and required hashes match before generation.
No exact output path exists before execution and no historical input path is opened for writing.
Each JSON output parses, uses UTF-8 with LF, has stable key ordering and is byte-identical across two in-memory generations from the same captured inputs.
All successor registers bind only PB-WALKSAFE-FEATURE-POLICY-1.0.1.
All successor registers carry the required path-set and content-set hashes and source_commit=null.
The module register has distinct user Android, administrator Android and Android gateway units; Web is legacy-only.
No successor marks the candidate model deployment-eligible or release-eligible.
Reused exact-source PASS, current exact-subject PASS, candidate source presence and formal results are represented as four non-interchangeable categories.
Every successor register and receipt keeps release_status=NOT_ELIGIBLE and makes no approval claim.
All three 2026-07-21 registers and the 2026-07-22 gap analysis are explicitly marked HISTORICAL_STALE references.
The receipt records byte count and SHA-256 for all three successor registers and itself excludes any self-referential receipt hash.

preflight: Reject if any exact output path exists.
Reject if a receipt with the refresh ID exists anywhere under the run directory.
Reject if an active execution marker for the refresh ID exists.

prohibited_expansions: Do not treat internal or reused PASS as formal 279 PASS.
Do not treat source presence as implementation completion.
Do not treat the administrator security boundary as complete operational administration.
Do not treat a model loaded by development runtime as deployment approval.
Do not treat disposable PostGIS evidence as production migration or recovery evidence.
Do not treat license metadata inventory as legal approval.
Do not claim clean commit, reproducible build, attestation, signing, deployment or release.
